story.title: Anthropic's Claude Now Writes Over 90% of Its Own Code, CFO Krishna Rao Reveals
story.summary: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao has disclosed that Claude, the company's flagship AI model, now generates more than 90% of Anthropic's internal codebase, a striking indicator of how AI is reshaping even the most AI-native workplaces. Despite this automation, Anthropic is continuing to hire, positioning AI as an amplifier of human talent rather than a replacement. The disclosure has immediate relevance for Indian software engineers and IT professionals who face growing pressure to justify their roles as AI coding tools mature.
